about: VRAM tiers for the render graphs. Read by soundstage/vram.py and web/ui/vramtier.mjs (a test keeps the JS copy identical). Only 48 is tested on hardware (RTX 6000 Ada); 24/16/12 are untested estimates. 16 GB numbers follow Arfolomew/backlot (MIT): LTX-2.5 w4a8 at 1280x704 on a 16 GB card.

48.note: 48 GB: everything as tested on the RTX 6000 Ada.

24.note: 24 GB (untested): text encoders on the CPU, int8 weights, stage 1 at most 544p (outputs up to 1088p, so Hollywood renders at 1088p, not 1408p), smaller decode tiles, models freed after each prompt.

16.note: 16 GB (untested): needs the w4a8 LTX-2.5 build for Motion. Stage 1 at most 352p (outputs up to 704p, the size backlot renders on 16 GB). Hollywood's x2 refine stays on but decodes in small tiles, so Hollywood = Final at 704p. Text encoders on the CPU, models freed after each prompt.

12.note: 12 GB (untested): the x2 refine is OFF for every preset, Hollywood included: Motion renders one pass at 512p. The w4a8 LTX-2.5 build (12.5 GB) still does not fit whole, so ComfyUI offloads part of it to system RAM: slow. Text encoders on the CPU, models freed after each prompt.
